snippet.title: September 20th Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Today we begin a brand new series, Pursing Joy: A Journey Through Philippians.

Our natural response in tough circumstances can often be to become disappointed or discouraged. But in the book of Philippians, Paul writes from prison to encourage a church he helped plant.

Today we will look at how partnership with the local church can be one of the greatest sources of joy in our lives!

Invite a friend or family member and join us!
